title: Stardew Valley Dynamic Day/Night | 16:9
description:
This description is formatted to be read on the Steam page. If you're reading this in the Wallpaper Engine app, please open this page in Steam.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Dynamic sun, moon, & sky according to your clock time (or a time of your choosing)
    [*]Enter your longitude and latitude for real-life syncing of sunrise and sunset times ([b]information is not collected[/b])
    [*]View the Valley in Spring, Summer, Fall, or Winter
    [*]5 weather types
    [*]FULL Stardew character creator, with up to 2 customizable Farmers visible
    [*]Up to 9 NPCs to chill on your desktop
    [*]Seasonal critters that traverse across the screen
    [*]Media viewer and audio visualizer
    [*]Extremely customizable (100+ options!)
    [*]Secrets!
[/list]

[h1]Contact Me![/h1]
[h3]Feature Changes & Requests Welcome![/h3]
If you have a request, question, concern, or bug to report, you can contact me by DM-ing [url=https://discord.com/users/560924526867775495]@.thebes[/url] on Discord, friending [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/thebooshy/]thebes[/url] on Steam, or commenting on this page/the dedicated forum thread. I'll do my best to solve any issues you may be having.

[h1]FAQ[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]I have a bug to report![/b] If you have an issue/bug to report, DM me on [url=https://discord.com/users/560924526867775495]Discord[/url]  or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/thebooshy/]Steam[/url] with a description and/or screenshots of the issue and your Wallpaper Engine log.txt file ([u]Wallpaper Engine > Manage > Browse Local Files > log.txt[/u]).
    [*][b]Is there any music included in this wallpaper?[/b] No, there is no music included in this wallpaper as I do not wish to redistribute music that I don't own.
    [*][b]The Media Viewer won't play any music?[/b] The Media Viewer only displays your currently playing media from an application on your PC such as Spotify, Apple Music, or a web browser. It itself does not play any audio.
    [*][b]There are missing/buggy textures![/b] To fix, unsubscribe from this wallpaper, fully close Wallpaper Engine, and then resubscribe to this wallpaper. If the problem persists, try verifying Wallpaper Engine's file integrity.
    [*][b]The Farmer customization buttons don't work![/b] Try updating your PC's graphics drivers and verifying Wallpaper Engine's file integrity. If that doesn't work, please contact me and I'll try to help find a solution with you.
[/list]

[h1]Credits[/h1]
[b]ConcernedApe[/b]: All assets unless otherwise stated ([u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/413150/Stardew_Valley/]go buy the game!![/url][/u]).
[u][url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/thebooshy/]thebes[/url][/u]: Main programming & development of the wallpaper, water shimmer effect, character editor Cancel icon.
[u][url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198367315392]Nautical[/url][/u]: Moon phase sprites, custom character beach & winter sprites, updated winter assets, removed Animal NPC drop shadows, character editor Save icon, color grading help, general feedback & support.
[b]chrismarquezz & osid54[/b]: Original version of the [u][url=https://stardewdle.com]Stardewdle.[/url][/u]

[b][i]And a special thank-you to everyone who has helped catch bugs and errors![/i][/b]
